gloss: to spoil; to pamper; to indulge

definitions.gloss: to spoil; to pamper; to indulge someone too much
definitions.explanation: To be overly lenient or indulgent with someone, especially a child, often with negative implications of producing bad behavior.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{甘|あま}やかしすぎると{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: It's not good to spoil children too much.

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}は{孫|まご}を{甘|あま}やかす{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: Grandparents tend to spoil their grandchildren.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{甘|あま}やかされて{育|そだ}った。
かわいいからといって{甘|あま}やかしてばかりいると、わがままな{子|こ}になるよ。
examples.english: If you keep spoiling them just because they're cute, they'll turn into a selfish child.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}が{子供|こども}を{甘|あま}やかしすぎた{結果|けっか}、{自分|じぶん}で{何|なに}もできない{大人|おとな}になってしまった。
examples.english: As a result of the parents spoiling the child too much, they grew into an adult who can't do anything on their own.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
・Pair: {甘|あま}える (to act spoiled, to depend on) - intransitive
・Pattern: XがYを{甘|あま}やかす

ASPECT:
・{甘|あま}やかしている = is spoiling (ongoing action)
・{甘|あま}やかされている = is being spoiled (passive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{子供|こども}を{甘|あま}やかす (to spoil a child)
・{甘|あま}やかして{育|そだ}てる (to raise someone in a spoiled manner)
・{甘|あま}やかされて{育|そだ}つ (to grow up spoiled)

NUANCE:
Unlike simply being kind, {甘|あま}やかす often implies excessive leniency that may have negative consequences. It suggests failing to discipline or set appropriate boundaries.
